title: Marketing copy
description: Gold entity: the marketing-copy content library (UIFPE-252). Materialized from the PDH staging table XXPSO_EGO_MARKET_COPY_DATA at version 'C' (current); 1 row per contentId. Serves the on-demand content retrieval behind the contentUrl field on gold_product.product's marketingCopy items — the content itself rides NO feed (api channel only; the claim-check pattern, see domains/product/docs/design-marketing-copy-content-service.md).

contentId.description: Content identifier — the natural key of the library, and the one path segment of the retrieval URL. Live-measured effectively unique at version 'C' (6,561,618 distinct across 6,561,622 rows, 2026-09-03).

marketingCopyTypeCode.description: Content type (60 distinct values at version 'C').

marketingCopyText.description: Short human-readable description of the copy.

marketingCopyContentText.description: The full marketing copy text (max 348,438 chars observed; avg 1,665). Null means nothing is published yet — the retrieval API answers 404 for such rows. Deliberately api-only: content never rides event or message feeds.
